record.bible_text: And he commanded<WH06680><WTH8762> the steward of his house<WH01004>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Fill<WH04390><WTH8761> the men's<WH0582> sacks<WH0572> <FI>with<Fi> food<WH0400>, as much as<WH0834> they can<WH03201><WTH8799> carry<WH05375><WTH8800>, and put<WH07760><WTH8798> every man's<WH0376> money<WH03701> in his sack's<WH0572> mouth<WH06310>. <RF>the steward...: Heb. him that was over his house<Rf>
